questions.question: When does DT3 pay, what are the dates, and what else should I know about how payment works?

expected.quote: Day 1 to Day 30 of a calendar month will be paid on the 7th day of the following month
expected.expected_answer: Paid monthly in arrears: work from day 1 to day 30 of a calendar month is paid on the 7th day of the following month. Pay is calculated from hours approved by DT3/Client, submitted weekly by timecard. DT3 does NOT withhold taxes - the consultant is responsible for all taxes. Schedule A sets [REDACTED] LKR per month from 14 September 2026.

questions.notes: Owner-authored. Multi-part: schedule, timecard basis, tax treatment, and Schedule A amount. Runs on the summarize profile, which nothing else in the set exercises.

result.answer: DT3 makes payments on a monthly basis [1]. Specifically, work completed from Day 1 to Day 30 of a calendar month is paid on the 7th day of the following month [1]. The payment amount is calculated based on the number of hours approved by DT3 or the Client, which the Consultant must submit weekly through a timecard [1]. Additionally, DT3 does not withhold taxes, meaning the Consultant is responsible for all taxes in accordance with Country, Federal, and State laws [1].
